item.title: Custom API endpoints completely broken in TRAE SOLO — internal trace errors instead of actual responses
item.body:
This is a regression that makes custom model support **entirely unusable** in TRAE SOLO 0.1.7.

**What happens:**
Configuring any custom API endpoint (Kimi Code, OpenRouter, Z.ai, MiniMax, etc.) results in an opaque internal trace error instead of an actual API response:

```
7636735428604068885:2707710561850c172c077b22a65e31d9_69fb2e6382bb1cda4f360a5a.69fb3051166ad7d913dc4932.69fb305182bb1cda4f360a5e:TRAE SOLO.0.1.7.no_sid.no_ppe.T(2026/5/6 20:13:05)
```

This is **not** an authentication error, **not** a rate limit, **not** a model error. The same API keys work perfectly in curl, Claude Code, VS Code extensions, and every other tool. Trae SOLO's proxy layer is failing to handle SSE streams or response formats from standard OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

**How to reproduce:**
1. Add any custom model (e.g., Kimi Code with `https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/chat/completions`)
2. Enter a valid API key that works in other tools
3. Send any prompt
4. Get the trace error above

**Expected behavior:**
The model responds.

**Actual behavior:**
An opaque internal trace ID that tells the user nothing.

**This is not acceptable.** Custom model support was advertised as a feature. Either fix the SSE parsing / proxy layer, or remove the feature entirely instead of wasting users' time with broken UI.

**Environment:**
- TRAE SOLO 0.1.7
- macOS
- Reproducible with multiple providers (Kimi, OpenRouter, Z.ai)
